shortDescription: CXMT Corp. has filed a lawsuit against the US Department of Defense seeking to be removed from a blacklist that identified the Chinese chipmaker as a supporter of China’s military, according to Bloomberg.The case challenges the Pentagon designation that put CXMT on the list.
